question: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park is situated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park is located in the Panchmahal district in the state of Gujarat, India.

• The site includes the remains of the capital of the state of Gujarat in the 16th century.

• It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2004.

• The park represents a perfect blend of Hindu-Muslim architecture and includes forts, palaces, religious buildings, residential precincts, and stepwells.
